selection_rule: Choose between the two preregistered models using fidelity to observed abundance quantiles/rank curve only; solver accuracy was not evaluated.
selection_result: empirical rank-resampling retained because it preserves the observed rank curve directly; the single log-normal has nonzero log-quantile error.
source: frozen production X on 15,837 foreground pixels
normalization_for_shape_only: Within each pixel, active abundances are divided by their active sum. Total signal scale is modeled separately from real B.

empirical_rank_resampling.future_sampling_rule: Sample one stored empirical descending normalized rank profile; truncate/interpolate only after the approved K is fixed, then renormalize weights to unit shape before applying B-norm scale.

preregistered_tail_scenarios.lighter_tail: Raise each sampled empirical rank weight to power 0.75, then renormalize to unit sum.
preregistered_tail_scenarios.central: Unmodified empirical rank-resampling profile, then renormalize to unit sum.
preregistered_tail_scenarios.heavier_tail: Raise each sampled empirical rank weight to power 1.25, then renormalize to unit sum.
preregistered_tail_scenarios.equal_abundance_control: All K active members receive weight 1/K; control only.

prohibition: Model choice and parameters must not be changed after viewing future solver accuracy.
